title: Recorded midgame production module candidates

selection.reason: Distinct product with low benchmark baseline output, visible demand gate, concentrated four-day harvest window; requires explicit tile and labor reservation.
selection.do_not_claim: Observed demand association and recorded output do not identify leader thresholds or prove module profitability.

visible_shop_gate.information_cutoff: planting decision hour; no future shop draws
visible_shop_gate.additional_gate: Projected current tomato supply (stock plus standing yields) leaves headroom against visible absorption; threshold to be set and held fixed before holdout.

growth.delivery_semantics: Yield accumulates at midnight ending crop-age days 8-11; harvest can begin next calendar day. Sales require shed inventory.

care_and_inputs.water: Water on planting day and at least every other day thereafter to avoid crop loss. The new plant starts at yield 0. Fertilizer bonus applies when watered on production calendar day; production resolves at that day end.
care_and_inputs.fertilizer: Optional separate arm. Requires fertilizer carried in the applying unit inventory; apply and water on a production calendar day to double that output, with the three-day effect window.
reserved_work: move unit inventory to shed by day end or DROP it there

modules.replacement: May replace a scheduled wheat planting visit only if the executor reserves this tile and the complete care/harvest route. Never overwrite an active strawberry cohort. Market SELL uses shed inventory; unit inventory must be deposited at day end or DROPed to the shed.
modules.interpretation: Strong concrete module hypothesis. Association with newly visible demand is supported; exact threshold and causal profit are unknown.

visible_shop_gate.information_cutoff: planting decision hour; no future shop draws
visible_shop_gate.additional_gate: Count inventory and scheduled yields before permitting a new cohort; require visible-demand headroom.

growth.delivery_semantics: Production resolves at midnight ending crop ages 10, 12, 14, 16; harvest can begin the next day. Plant day 12: harvest days 22,24,26,28. Plant day 16: days 26,28,30,32, so only two outputs can be harvested in-season. Sales require shed inventory.

care_and_inputs.water: Water on planting day and never allow two consecutive missed days; fertilizer bonus applies when watered on a production calendar day, before midnight production.
care_and_inputs.fertilizer: Optional separate arm. Requires fertilizer carried in the applying unit inventory; apply and water on a production calendar day to double that output, with the three-day effect window.
reserved_work: deposit unit inventory into shed at day end or DROP to shed

modules.replacement: A small demand-gated addition or wheat-visit replacement only with reserved labor. Preserve remaining production on existing strawberry tiles.
modules.interpretation: Strong evidence of response to newly visible demand, but not of profitable unconditional planting. Especially sensitive to total market supply.

visible_shop_gate.information_cutoff: planting decision hour; no future shop draws
visible_shop_gate.additional_gate: Only plant where visible absorption and a full age-3 harvest/delivery commitment fit.

care_and_inputs.water: Water on planting day or crop becomes weed at day end. Water on ages 2 and 3 for three units without fertilizer; fertilize no later than age 1, then water on ages 2 and 3 to reach the four-unit cap. Harvest after age-3 watering before the tile expires.
care_and_inputs.fertilizer: Needed to reach listed maximum of four; test separately with inventory and production schedule reserved.
reserved_work: deposit unit inventory into shed at day end or DROP to shed

modules.replacement: Potentially substitute at a native planting visit; do not swap seed type without confirming a harvest visit before the short deadline.
modules.interpretation: Short cycle is executor-friendly in principle, but its later count is inconsistent and carries substantial visit-timing risk.

causal_and_hindsight_limits.observational_basis: 52 recent matches; leader quantities correlate with open shop composition; within-game event study controls segment index.
causal_and_hindsight_limits.causal_limit: Shop names and shop-caused prices are not separated. Correlation does not reveal their exact policy or prove these cohorts add cash.
causal_and_hindsight_limits.majkel_rule_limit: Majkel has same-history action divergences, so its conditional rule is not identifiable from replays.
causal_and_hindsight_limits.anti_hindsight_rule: Candidate triggers may inspect only already-unlocked shops, current stock, standing crops, and currently known prices at decision time. Never use later shops, completed-season revenue, or hindsight best cohort selection.

proof_requirements: Executor can identify and own each planted tile.
Reserve the complete water, fertilizer if selected, harvest, and delivery schedule before spending seeds.
Run separate no-fertilizer and explicit-fertilizer arms.
Evaluate paired held-out shop sequences, both seats, fixed opponents, reporting own cash and margin.
Record planted crops, missed care, yields harvested, delivery, unused seed/fertilizer, and any lost incumbent yield.

claim_provenance.leader_statistics: docs/leader_segments.md §§Evidence base, 3a/3b, §4; source segment aggregates are results/fresh/leader_segments/segments-*.json and summary.json
claim_provenance.interpretation: Observed shop associations do not identify the exact production rule or establish causal profitability; candidate triggers use only currently unlocked shops and current state.
